For Dad

Seventy years of stories, strength, humour, and family.

This is not just a weekend away. It is a thank-you, a toast, a pause, and a chance to gather the people who love you in one unforgettable place.

📍 Storyline

This trip starts as a roadtrip, settles into a desert stay, and turns into a birthday story: arrive in the rocks, gather around the table, look up at the stars, and head home feeling like you were properly away.

At the heart of it all is you, Dad — the Man of the Moment. This weekend is about celebrating you: your stories, your humour, your quiet strength, and the way you have brought this family together over the years.

It is our chance to slow down, raise a glass, share the kinds of moments that become family legends, and make sure you know exactly how deeply loved and appreciated you are.
